paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: show your DeepSeek account balance above the account row
# DeepSeek Balance for DeepSeek Harness
**Show your DeepSeek account balance right above the account row in the DSH sidebar.**
**English** · 中文
## What it is

A client-side plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It renders one row in the
sidebar footer, direc

tly above the account row (avatar + nickname), showing the
DeepSeek wallet balance for the signed-in

account. Hovering or focusing the row
opens a details popover; clicking it forces a refresh.

The package is `@local/dsh-balance`, the row id is `balance`, and the plugin
appears in the plugin m
anager as **DeepSeek Balance**.
## Features

- **One-glance balance** — a 24px wallet glyph plus the primary-currency total,
rendered as a single

row above the account row.
- **Pixel-aligned with the account row** — 44px row height, 14px tabular

numerals, 6px padding, 8px gap. The row is widened 2px on each side so the
icon and the avatar shar

e a left edge, and the amount and the nickname share
one too.
- **Per-currency details on hover** —

total, top-up balance, bonus balance for
every currency, the last update time (relative; absolute on

hover), and the
**Usage** / **Top up** links.
- **Manual refresh** — click the row, or press Enter

/ Space
when it is focused, to bypass the focus throttle.
- **Automatic refresh that survives a coll

apsed sidebar** — every trigger is
bound to the plugin lifecycle, not to the row component's mount.

- **Threshold colors** — the CNY total turns amber below the warn threshold and
red below the danger

threshold. USD never triggers a color; both light and
dark themes are covered.
- **Honest states**

— signed out, first load, and read failures are visually
distinct; a failed read keeps the last good

value and adds a gray ⚠.
- **Configurable** — polling switch, polling interval and both CNY thresho

lds
are editable in the plugin settings page and apply without reloading.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` and pnpm — build-tim

Seek Harness Desktop `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` and pnpm — build-time only
## Install
This is a **local** plugin: it is installed from a checkout, not from npm.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then **fully quit and restart DSH**. The client bundle is loaded once when the
Web frontend starts,
and external plugins have no hot-reload promise.

Use `--profile <name>` for a profile other than `desktop`. Installation writes
the dependency and a

`link:` symlink into
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and its `node_modules`.

> `lib/client.js` is a build artifact and is not committed, which is why the
> `pnpm build` step is
required before installing.
### Uninstall

Restart DSH afterwards for the row to disappear.
## Configuration

Open **Plugin manager → Plugins → DeepSeek Balance → Configuration**. The fields
are volatile host c

onfiguration, so a save takes effect on the next refresh
without reloading the plugin.
| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `pollingEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Run the fallback poll while the page is visible. |
| `pollin

gIntervalMs` | number | `60000` | Poll interval in ms, 15000–600000. |
| `warnThresholdCny` | number

| `10` | CNY total below this turns the amount amber. |
| `dangerThresholdCny` | number | `1` | CNY
total below this turns it red; must stay below `warnThresholdCny` (validated in the settings page).
otal below this turns it red; must stay below `warnThresholdCny` (validated in the settings page). |
The initial values also live in `cordis.patch.yml`.
## Refresh behavior

Every trigger is owned by the plugin lifecycle (`src/client.tsx`,
`ctx.effect(() => controller.attac

h())`), not by the row component, so collapsing
the sidebar — which unmounts the row — does not stop

automatic refresh. Rationale
in ADR 0001.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- `sidebar.footer.action` is a DSH-internal slot, not a documented public API.
A DSH upgrade (especi

ally 0.3) may change its name, props, or neighbors.
- External client bundles have no hot reload: re

build and restart DSH to see
changes.
- Local installation only — this package is not published to n

pm.
- Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account; when signed out, the row only says so.
- Threshold colo

rs apply to the CNY total only. With multiple currencies the row
shows CNY (or the first currency wh

en there is no CNY).
- The host half declares `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` as a peer dependency and
re
lies on the DSH runtime to resolve it.
## 功能特性

- **一眼可见余额** — 24px 钱包图标 + 主币种合计，占一行，位于账户行上方。
- **与账户行逐像素对齐** — 行高 44px、字号 14px（等宽数字）、内边距 6px、间距
8px

；左右各外扩 2px，使图标与头像左缘、金额与昵称左缘对齐。
- **悬停查看分币种明细** — 每个币种的总额、充值余额、赠金余额、上次更新时间
（相对时间，悬停显示绝对时间），以及「用量」「充值」

入口。
- **手动刷新** — 点击整行，或聚焦后按 Enter / Space，
绕过 focus 节流立即读取。
- **收起侧边栏也不中断自动刷新** — 全部触发源挂在插件生命周期上，而不是

行组件
的挂载/卸载。
- **阈值配色** — CNY 合计低于警戒值显示橙色、低于危险值显示红色；USD 不参与
判定；明暗主题均有适配。
- **状态诚实** — 未登录、首次加载、读取失败各有

独立视觉状态；失败时保留上一次
成功的数值并显示灰色 ⚠。
- **可配置** — 轮询开关、轮询间隔、两个 CNY 阈值均可在插件设置页修改，保存即时
生效，无需重载插件。
## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` 与 pnpm（仅构建时需要）
## 已知限制

- `sidebar.footer.action` 是 DSH 内部插槽，未在公开文档中承诺；DSH 升级（尤其
0.3）可能改变其名称、props 或相邻布局。
- 外部插件的客户端代码没有热更新承

诺：改完 `pnpm build` 后需重启 DSH。
- 仅支持本地安装，未发布到 npm。
- 仅对已登录的 DeepSeek 账户可用；未登录时行内只提示登录。
- 阈值配色只对 CNY 合计生

效；多币种时余额行显示 CNY（无 CNY 时显示第一个币种）。
- Host 半依赖安装包提供的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（peerDependency，由 DSH
运行

CNY（无 CNY 时显示第一个币种）。
- Host 半依赖安装包提供的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（peerDependency，由 DSH
运行时解析，不随插件打包）。
